answer_1.quote: Participants will apply their techniques to summaries of basketball games produced from box score (and other game data) by neural NLG systems.

answer_4.quote: The protocol of Thomson and Reiter (2020) asks for each text to be fact‑checked by three annotators. ... we will carefully fact‑check, using the protocol of ... 60 texts (twenty from each system).
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators fact‑check each generated summary, marking each mistake with its position and error category.
